name: rex-tty
description: Inside the Rex terminal, runs the Bash commands that need a real terminal (sudo, gh auth login, git rebase -i, a key passphrase) in a Rex pane beside the session, where you type; Claude gets the exit code and what the pane showed: input typed at a hidden prompt (a password, a passphrase) is never returned, visible or echoed input is, unless returnOutput is off. Adds a tty_run tool for commands that failed without a terminal.

commands.title: Extra commands
commands.description: Comma-separated regex sources: a Bash command that matches one also runs in a Rex pane

skip.title: Never send
skip.description: Comma-separated regex sources: a Bash command that matches one always runs as usual

side.title: Pane side
side.description: Where the pane opens relative to the session: below, right, above or left

ratio.title: Pane size
ratio.description: Percent of the split the pane takes (10-90)

closeOnExit.title: Close the pane when the command ends
closeOnExit.description: Off keeps every pane open until you close it; a pane whose command timed out is always kept

returnOutput.title: Give Claude the pane's output
returnOutput.description: Off returns only the exit code, for commands that print secrets on screen

timeoutMinutes.title: Wait limit
timeoutMinutes.description: Minutes to wait for the command to end before Claude is told it is still running (1-720)
